text: In general it's not ideal to be without a visa, but it does sound like you have it in writing from PIBA that they are okay with it. It shouldn't cause any practical drama with Bitucah Leumi/Maccabi, as there is a grace period of around a couple of months. With work, they might feel uncomfortable about it and you might need to show them PIBA's email - but they also might not even notice if you don't say anything. Up to you :)
